commands: set -euo pipefail; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; git fetch --prune origin main ui/radar-details-redesign; git checkout ui/radar-details-redesign; git merge --ff-only origin/ui/radar-details-redesign; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = '72a7bb879e4537190eaca5298146acb6ecde25ca'; echo '=== DIFF CHECK ==='; git diff --check origin/main...HEAD; echo '=== CHANGED FILES ==='; git diff --name-status origin/main...HEAD; echo '=== DIFF STAT ==='; git diff --stat origin/main...HEAD

set -euo pipefail; echo '=== REQUIRED ENTRYPOINTS ==='; for f in README.md AGENTS.md CONTRIBUTING.md FIELD_SESSION_CHECKLIST.md .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md docs/README.md docs/UI_UX_REDESIGN_PLAN.md docs/PRODUCT_GOAL.md docs/ARCHITECTURE_CURRENT.md docs/SANDBOX_EXECUTION_FLOW.md docs/PHASE3_FIELD_REACCEPTANCE_CLOSURE_2026-09-11.md; do test -f "$f"; echo "OK $f"; done; grep -q 'PHASE 3 ACCEPTED / CLOSED; PHASE 4 UNBLOCKED' docs/PHASE3_FIELD_REACCEPTANCE_CLOSURE_2026-09-11.md; grep -q 'Active plan' docs/UI_UX_REDESIGN_PLAN.md; grep -q 'Current project status' docs/README.md || grep -q 'Current project status' README.md

set -euo pipefail; echo '=== STALE ACTIVE POINTER CHECK ==='; active='README.md AGENTS.md CONTRIBUTING.md FIELD_SESSION_CHECKLIST.md .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md docs/README.md docs/UI_UX_REDESIGN_PLAN.md docs/PRODUCT_GOAL.md docs/ARCHITECTURE_CURRENT.md docs/SANDBOX_EXECUTION_FLOW.md'; ! grep -nE 'physical field evidence pending|PAUSED until the recovery stability gate|Read `docs/STABILITY_RECOVERY_GUIDE.md` and its `NEXT ACTION`|Canonical product/recovery plan: `docs/STABILITY_RECOVERY_GUIDE.md`|Which phase from docs/STABILITY_RECOVERY_GUIDE.md' $active; grep -q 'HISTORICAL STATUS NOTICE' docs/STABILITY_RECOVERY_GUIDE.md; grep -q 'HISTORICAL STATUS NOTICE' docs/PHASE3_HANDOFF.md; grep -q 'HISTORICAL STATUS NOTICE' docs/PHASE3_FIELD_COLLECTION.md; grep -q 'HISTORICAL STATUS NOTICE' docs/PHASE3_PRE_FIELD_GOLDEN.md; grep -q 'HISTORICAL STATUS NOTICE' docs/PHASE3_TARGETED_PHYSICAL_ACCEPTANCE.md; echo DOC_STATUS_AUDIT_PASS; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
